funFact: The hoatzin was an evolutionary enigma for over a century, bouncing between gamebirds, cuckoos, and turacos. Recent genomic studies placed it as one of the earliest-diverging lineages of Neoaves — the same major bird group as crows, parrots, and most living birds. Chickens are Galloanserae, an older lineage that split off before Neoaves even existed. Despite the hoatzin's gamebird-like look, it shares a more recent common ancestor with the crow.
